description:
Mental Clarity Music | Slow Sarod | Brain Fog Reset

If your brain feels like it's been running on 4% battery since Wednesday — start here. Sarod's bright, articulate strings are like coffee in audio form: clean, sharp, no jitter.

90 minutes of slow sarod music, paired with a gentle brainwave layer that supports focused attention.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarod — a bright, clear Indian string instrument (think clean staccato notes, not slides)
- Long phrases with space between notes — calm but never drowsy
- A gentle 40Hz layer associated with focused thinking (use headphones for the effect)
- Unbroken sound — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first focused breath
12:00  Mental fog clearing
35:00  Focused attention zone
60:00  Sustained clarity
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Don't try to focus — let the strings pull your attention into shape. Headphones recommended. Phone in another room.

⏱ Best for:
• End-of-work-week brain fog
• Post-lunch slump
• Pre-deadline focus
• Study and concentration sessions
• Friday-afternoon mental reset

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus
